summary.title: Ably Examples - Code Samples and Implementation Guides
summary.one_liner: This page is an index of Ably code examples covering chat, pub/sub, presence, LiveCounter/LiveMap, and collaboration features, and it links to the Vue peer-to-peer multi-user game tutorial.
takeaways: Ably offers example projects for chat, pub/sub, presence, and shared data structures.
Examples cover collaboration features such as live cursors, avatar stacks, member location, and component locking.
The page is a listing; the Vue 2 peer-to-peer multi-user game tutorial is one entry in it under the Vue section.
Examples include AI response token streaming and message append for streamed text.
summary.summary: This is the index page of Ably's code examples and implementation guides. It lists short example descriptions grouped by product area, including chat (presence, history, messages, typing indicators, reactions), pub/sub channels (presence, occupancy, history, encryption, annotations), LiveCounter and LiveMap state sync, and collaboration features like live cursors and avatar stacks. The page itself contains no tutorial steps; the Vue 2 peer-to-peer game tutorial is only referenced via the listing and its details are not in the page text.
